name: Lead gen pipeline
description: Runs the full lead chain in one process: discover → dedupe → enrich → tech-signals → find-decision-makers → suppress → verify → qualify → draft → export.

env.name: LEAD_DRY_RUN
env.description: Propagates to all steps (browser jobs skip risky actions)

env.name: LEAD_RUN_ID
env.description: Reuse run; unset creates new id on discover

env.name: LEAD_PIPELINE_FROM
env.description: Optional step id to start from (e.g. lead-enrich-company)

env.name: LEAD_PIPELINE_TO
env.description: Optional step id to stop after
